fact: The 2022 Population and Housing Census reported a population of 61.7 million (61,741,120), published as the Basic Demographic and Socio-Economic Profile Report, the fourth in the series of major census publications.
title: The 2022 Population and Housing Census: Tanzania Basic Demographic and Socio-Economic Profile Report
publisher: National Bureau of Statistics and Office of the Chief Government Statistician Zanzibar
